about: Round 2, per your note: way faster. 53 hits + the cup drop in 22 s (about 2.5 sounds every second, was under 1). Every hit is the same 0.4 s window (a split second of downswing, contact, a beat of the ball leaving) so it plays like a steady rhythm. Still no talking, no music, every hit about equally loud, contact never cut, shirts/days never back to back. Drives, irons, bunker splashes, chips and putts mixed, ends on the ball dropping in the cup. "asmr but it's golf" for the first 2 s only (smaller, bolder and lower since Oct 17). Covers and caption unchanged.
caption: very peaceful sport
